name: Cauliflower
tile_uses: The roast chicken pan, the warm lentils
why_now: Cauliflower is a cool-season crop, and it's sweeter and denser now than at any time in summer. Roasted hard, it turns nutty and golden at the edges.
how_to_choose: Tight, creamy-white curds with no brown spots
Fresh, green leaves hugging the head
buy_this_much: 1 head for each cauliflower dish you pick.
price_note: Sold by the head. A heavier head for the same price is more cauliflower.

flavor_paths.name: With lentils
flavor_paths.description: Warm, with pickled fennel and a fried egg.

flavor_paths.name: With Parmesan
flavor_paths.description: Grated over while it's still hot.

weekday_uses: Roasted on the sheet pan with chicken thighs
Roasted and folded into warm lentils
weekend_use: Leftover florets, crisped in a skillet, under a fried egg.
storage: In the fridge, unwashed, in a loose bag, for up to a week.
one_thing_to_learn: Cauliflower is mostly water, so it browns only when it has room. Spread it out on the pan with space around each piece; crowded, it steams and stays pale.
